title: Student Handbook - Enrollment
content:
Enrollment opens two weeks before the semester starts. Students add electives through the online student portal, then confirm with an academic advisor for final approval. A waitlist opens after the first week of classes.

Priority enrollment windows: seniors, then juniors, then sophomores, then first-years. Each student may add up to 2 electives per term.

title: Financial Aid & Scholarships
content:
Financial aid applications open on March 15 and close on June 30. Students must submit the FAFSA or national aid form plus a scholarship statement of purpose. Awards are released within 3 weeks.

Need-based grants cover up to 60% of tuition and can be combined with merit awards. Emergency micro-grants are available within 48 hours through the Student Success Center.

title: Academic Calendar Highlights
content:
Fall semester classes begin August 19. Midterm exams run October 7-11. Final exams take place December 10-17. Spring semester begins January 13 with finals May 5-12.

Reading week is scheduled for November 18-22. Registration for spring electives opens November 1.

title: Housing & Hostel Info
content:
On-campus hostel fees range from $1,200 to $1,450 per semester depending on room type. First-year students receive priority housing assignments and can apply for roommate matching.

Check-in starts five days before classes. Meal plans are included with all hostel contracts.

title: Campus Facilities
content:
The main library is open 8am-11pm on weekdays and 10am-8pm on weekends. Students access study rooms through the library app.

Labs, sports center, and maker space require a valid student ID. Wellness services offer drop-in counseling Monday to Friday.

title: Campus Policies
content:
Attendance is required for all core courses with a maximum of two unexcused absences. Academic integrity violations follow a three-step review process.

Student conduct expectations cover respectful behavior, inclusive language, and safety guidelines during campus events.
